package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"path"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	maximumTeacherCodeFiles     = 12
	maximumTeacherCodeFileBytes = 16 << 10
	maximumTeacherCodeTotal     = 64 << 10
)

type LearningActionCodeSandbox interface {
	FindSandboxForAnswer(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskID, answerID string) (*domain.SandboxSession, error)
	GetSnapshot(ctx context.Context, sandboxID string) ([]domain.WorkspaceFile, error)
	GetValidationObservation(ctx context.Context, sandboxID string) (domain.LearningActionValidationObservation, error)
}

// GetLearningActionCodeContext resolves and sanitizes the exact workspace for
// one open Student-owned action. Answer and Sandbox identities stay private.
type GetLearningActionCodeContext struct {
	Actions repository.LearningActionReader
	Sandbox LearningActionCodeSandbox
}

func (useCase GetLearningActionCodeContext) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, learningActionID string) (domain.LearningActionCodeContext, error) {
	studentID, learningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID)
	if useCase.Actions == nil || useCase.Sandbox == nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, fmt.Errorf("learning action code context dependencies are required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(learningActionID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	action, err := useCase.Actions.GetByStudentAndID(ctx, studentID, learningActionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, err
	}
	if action.StudentID != studentID || action.ID != learningActionID {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	// Practice v2 bindings intentionally have no answer or Sandbox identity.
	// Never try to derive one from their context/task instance.
	if strings.TrimSpace(action.StudentTaskAnswerID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(action.TaskID) == "" {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	actionContext, err := domain.NewLearningActionContext(action)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid stored learning action", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if actionContext.Status != domain.LearningActionStatusOpen {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	base := domain.LearningActionCodeContext{
		LearningActionID: action.ID,
		StudentID:        action.StudentID,
		TaskID:           action.TaskID,
		PolicyVersion:    domain.LearningActionCodeContextPolicyVersion,
		Validation: domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{
			PolicyVersion: domain.SandboxValidationObservationVersion,
		},
	}
	sandbox, err := useCase.Sandbox.FindSandboxForAnswer(ctx, action.StudentID, action.TaskID, action.StudentTaskAnswerID)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.NewLearningActionCodeContext(base)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, fmt.Errorf("find learning action sandbox: %w", err)
	}
	if sandbox == nil || strings.TrimSpace(sandbox.SandboxID) == "" {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, errors.New("learning action sandbox response is invalid")
	}
	files, err := useCase.Sandbox.GetSnapshot(ctx, sandbox.SandboxID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, fmt.Errorf("read learning action workspace: %w", err)
	}
	validation, err := useCase.Sandbox.GetValidationObservation(ctx, sandbox.SandboxID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionCodeContext{}, fmt.Errorf("read learning action validation observation: %w", err)
	}
	base.Available = true
	base.Files, base.OmittedFileCount = boundedTeacherCodeFiles(files)
	base.Truncated = base.OmittedFileCount > 0
	base.Validation = validation
	for _, file := range base.Files {
		base.Truncated = base.Truncated || file.Truncated
	}
	return domain.NewLearningActionCodeContext(base)
}

func boundedTeacherCodeFiles(files []domain.WorkspaceFile) ([]domain.LearningActionCodeFile, int) {
	type candidate struct {
		path    string
		content string
	}
	candidates := make([]candidate, 0, len(files))
	omitted := 0
	for _, file := range files {
		filePath, ok := safeTeacherCodePath(file.Path)
		if !ok || isSensitiveReviewPath(file.Path) || !utf8.ValidString(file.Content) || strings.ContainsRune(file.Content, '\x00') {
			omitted++
			continue
		}
		candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: filePath, content: redactReviewSecrets(file.Content)})
	}
	sort.SliceStable(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].path < candidates[j].path })
	result := make([]domain.LearningActionCodeFile, 0, min(len(candidates), maximumTeacherCodeFiles))
	seen, total := make(map[string]struct{}, len(candidates)), 0
	for _, item := range candidates {
		if _, exists := seen[item.path]; exists {
			omitted++
			continue
		}
		seen[item.path] = struct{}{}
		if len(result) == maximumTeacherCodeFiles || total == maximumTeacherCodeTotal {
			omitted++
			continue
		}
		limit := min(maximumTeacherCodeFileBytes, maximumTeacherCodeTotal-total)
		content, truncated := truncateTeacherCode(item.content, limit)
		result = append(result, domain.LearningActionCodeFile{Path: item.path, Content: content, Truncated: truncated})
		total += len(content)
	}
	return result, omitted
}

func safeTeacherCodePath(value string) (string, bool) {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(value, "\\", "/"))
	if normalized == "" || strings.HasPrefix(normalized, "/") || strings.ContainsRune(normalized, '\x00') || !utf8.ValidString(normalized) {
		return "", false
	}
	normalized = path.Clean(normalized)
	if normalized == "." || normalized == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(normalized, "../") || len(normalized) > 300 {
		return "", false
	}
	segments := strings.Split(strings.ToLower(normalized), "/")
	for _, segment := range segments {
		switch segment {
		case ".git", "node_modules", "vendor", "dist", "build", "coverage", "target", ".next", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv":
			return "", false
		}
	}
	base := segments[len(segments)-1]
	if strings.HasSuffix(base, ".lock") || base == "package-lock.json" || base == "yarn.lock" || base == "pnpm-lock.yaml" ||
		strings.HasSuffix(base, ".png") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".jpg") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".jpeg") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(base, ".gif") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".webp") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".ico") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(base, ".pdf") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".zip") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".gz") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(base, ".woff") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".woff2") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".ttf") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(base, ".exe") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".dll") || strings.HasSuffix(base, ".so") {
		return "", false
	}
	return normalized, true
}

func truncateTeacherCode(content string, limit int) (string, bool) {
	if len(content) <= limit {
		return content, false
	}
	content = content[:limit]
	for !utf8.ValidString(content) {
		content = content[:len(content)-1]
	}
	return content, true
}
